description: This file defines the CurlFactory class which implements the creation, configuration, and management of cURL handles for HTTP requests within the GuzzleHttp library. It includes methods for creating cURL resources, handling request options, releasing handles, and processing transfer statistics and errors.

classes.name: CurlFactory
classes.description: A class responsible for creating, configuring, and releasing cURL handles for executing HTTP requests.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and configures a new EasyHandle resource for the given request and options.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases an EasyHandle resource, either by caching or closing it.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Completes a cURL transaction, returning a fulfilled or rejected promise based on success or failure.

methods.name: invokeStats
methods.description: Captures and invokes transfer statistics callback.

methods.name: finishError
methods.description: Handles error case when cURL transfer fails, returning an appropriate rejected promise.

methods.name: createRejection
methods.description: Creates a rejected promise with the error information from cURL failure.

methods.name: getDefaultConf
methods.description: Generates default cURL configuration options based on the request.

methods.name: applyMethod
methods.description: Applies HTTP method-specific options to the cURL configuration.

methods.name: applyBody
methods.description: Configures the request body handling in cURL options.

methods.name: applyHeaders
methods.description: Sets request headers in cURL options.

methods.name: removeHeader
methods.description: Removes a specific header from the configuration array.

methods.name: applyHandlerOptions
methods.description: Applies additional handler options like SSL settings, proxy, timeouts, and debug options.

methods.name: retryFailedRewind
methods.description: Retries the request if the previous attempt failed due to rewind issues.

methods.name: createHeaderFn
methods.description: Creates a callback function to process response headers during cURL execution.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor method to close cached handle resources upon object destruction.
